name: After § 2
title: REPORT on competition policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 2a. Stresses that, in defining relevant markets and assessing a competitive playing field, the EU should take the global market, and not solely the European market, as its frame of reference; calls also for EU competition policy to move beyond an exclusive focus on low prices for consumers by integrating production-side realities, so as to support a stronger, innovation-driven and sustainable industrial base;
